text:
Maya: quick proposal / lightweight ABI checker for adapter manifests. goal: catch regressions when moving config between hosted/dedicated/private.

Dan: interesting. what's considered "breaking" vs "advisory"?

Maya: basic ruleset: removing required keys (auth, routing, telemetry) = breaking; changing credential surface has graded severity; capability flags (kv_cache, latency_hint) = advisory by default.

Li: credential transitions are the pain. suggest explicit `credential_kind` enum (kms, hsm, volume, ephemeral, none). checker rules: kms->volume = breaking unless migration note; kms->ephemeral = advisory unless `grace_window` present.

Sasha: runtime knobs (kernel, quant) shouldn't be marked breaking. put them under `capabilities` and keep them advisory. teams can opt-into strict mode to make advisory breaking.

Dan: telemetry regressions need loud warnings. removing `.telemetry.tags` should require a migration note.

Maya: agreed. output format: machine JSON + 1-line human summary. example: "{"breaking":["auth.credential_path"], "advisory":["capabilities.kv_cache.layout"], "score":72}" and human: "Compatibility 72 12 breaking: auth.credential_path; advisory: capabilities.kv_cache.layout"

deploy-bot: CI hint: `/ci run abi-check --manifest=adapter.json --baseline=prev.json --out=json` will post annotations. canary job `canary/abi-check/4267801234` queued.

Li: i'll draft the credential_kind mapping and tests (hosted->dedicated, hosted->private, private->dedicated).

Sasha: i'll write fallback semantics doc: which credential_kind wins when hosted falls back, and how to prioritize.

Dan: for gating: propose score <60 = block for dedicated/private; 60-80 = owner signoff; >80 = auto. allowlist exceptions per repo. i'll draft gating proposal.

Maya: plan: PoC Python checker + JSON Schema by Fri. step 1: schema + diff engine, step 2: probe integration non-blocking for 2 weeks, step 3: opt-in CI gate.

Sasha: add small test corpus and a couple of example manifests.

Li: will add tests under infra/abi-checker/tests as part of PoC.

Maya: action items: Maya: PoC + samples (Fri), Li: credential_kind + tests, Dan: CI gate thresholds, Sasha: fallback doc.

Dan: +1
